title: The Gentoo Penguin Swims Underwater at 22 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: This bird swims almost as fast as Usain Bolt runs.
It is the gentoo penguin, and it hits twenty-two miles an hour underwater.
That is about thirty-six kilometres an hour.
Guinness World Records names it the fastest swimming bird on Earth.
Bolt's average in his 2008 world record was just a little faster, on land.
A bird that cannot fly, almost keeping up with the fastest sprinter alive.

description:
The gentoo penguin can swim underwater at about 22 miles an hour, which Guinness World Records lists as the fastest speed of any swimming bird.
Usain Bolt's average in his 2008 world record was only slightly faster, on land.
Who would win a race, you or a penguin? Comment below.
first_comment: A penguin at 22 miles an hour. Would you bet on the sprinter or the bird in a pool race?
